checks.detail: 21 of 21 checks: every C program compiled with gcc 13.3 (-std=c17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror), and every terminal session replayed on Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64 with QEMU 8.2 and the aarch64-linux-gnu toolchain, output compared line by line. Machine-dependent values (times, addresses, process numbers, build IDs, buffer sizes) are shown as ... .

Timings, system call numbers and counts, file sizes and disassembly observed on the test machine and labelled as such. Installation steps for WSL 2, a macOS virtual machine, Chromebooks and the Raspberry Pi are described from the official procedures and are not replayed (no Pi on the test machine).
